notes: Ruka 0.3.96: true parallel editors and benchmark. parallel_edit runs real editor tool loops inside isolated git worktrees, supports 1-3 best-of-N candidates, acceptance-command selection, commits candidate changes, merges winners one at a time through a test-gated integration branch, and rolls back failed merges. parallel_benchmark measures worktree creation, parallel patches, merge success, final tests, conflict detection and serial-vs-parallel time on deterministic tasks. Includes 0.3.95 FCC provider and 0.3.94 compaction canaries/gates/budgets.
